column1: # tcl-lsp root-workspace nextest binary shards.
# Each eligible lib, bin, or integration-test harness belongs to exactly one
# execution shard or verified @dedicated workflow/script/xtask owner. All
# shards still select the whole workspace with
# --all-features; the runner builds every lib/bin harness plus only its
# assigned integration targets, preserving feature unification while avoiding
# repeated links for hundreds of unrelated integration binaries.
# A crate's integration-test files assigned to one shard are modules of one
# harness, tests/it_<k>/main.rs (target `it_<k>`), so a shard links one binary
# per crate rather than one per file; see test-tiers-and-ci-gates.md.
# Initial weights came from the complete 2026-09-07 CI run; hosted shards 2-5
# were rebalanced on 2026-11-12 light-tier timings. The verifier
# derives target coverage from locked Cargo metadata; a new or renamed target
# fails closed until this table assigns it.
